Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 40 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Anil - 39 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Pihu - 9 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
5. Savitri - 63 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Kunal stands by the road. Sunita, Anil and Pihu stand near him.]

Sunita: "Pihu, what's the plan today?"

[Kunal gets into the car.]

Sunita: "Exactly right."

[Kunal gets off the school bus.]

Kunal: "Yes, of course."

[Kunal hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Kunal (gently): "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The garden - Day

Sunita: "Let's begin."

[Kunal waters the plants.]

Sunita: "That's easy."

[Kunal chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Kunal: "I really enjoyed today."
